description: Implementation of StringOutputBuffer class for managing string data with file I/O operations, including appending data, comparing contents with files, and writing data to files.

classes.name: StringOutputBuffer
classes.description: A class that manages a buffer of strings with support for appending, comparing, and writing to files.

methods.name: str
methods.description: Returns the concatenated string of all pages in the buffer.

methods.name: Append
methods.description: Appends a string or character to the buffer.

methods.name: ContentsEqual
methods.description: Checks if the buffer contents are equal to the contents of a specified file.

methods.name: WriteToFile
methods.description: Writes the buffer contents to a specified file.

methods.name: WriteToFileIfChanged
methods.description: Writes the buffer to a file only if the contents differ.
